copper_structure_retrieval_subtask_melti.name: Copper Structure Retrieval for Melting
copper_structure_retrieval_subtask_melti.description: Retrieve structure of Copper and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

copper_potential_file_subtask_melting.name: Copper Potential File for Melting
copper_potential_file_subtask_melting.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Copper for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

copper_nvt_subtask_melting.name: Copper NVT Equilibration for melting
copper_nvt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Copper structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, equilibrate the system under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in x, y and z direction. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in g/cm^3.
copper_nvt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"density" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}

copper_npt_subtask_melting.name: Copper NPT Equilibration for melting
copper_npt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible nvt equilibrated Copper structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the system under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and final density in gm/cm^3.
copper_npt_subtask_melting.submission_format: {"density" : numerical value without units, "path to relaxed structure" : path} eg, {"density" : 56.00, "path to relaxed structure" : /structures/structure.dat}

copper_melting_npt_subtask_melting.name: Copper NPT Melting
copper_melting_npt_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible npt equilibrated Copper structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the equilibrated system by heating it under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Report the final density in g/cm^3.
